title: Home-based child care
hypothesis: A public state child-care directory can identify a licensed provider and its explicitly published business contact field, but provider, administrator, and owner must remain distinct and every home-location address must be excluded from contact delivery.
ownerSource: PA OCDEL responsible person only when its published title is OWNER; NY OCFS provider is a provider candidate; TX operation name is a provider candidate only when it is a person. An administrator/director is never owner-confirming evidence.
phoneSource: The PA, NY, and TX directories publish a facility phone as a business-contact field. It is not a personal-cell, owner, line-type, reachability, or DNC result; retain it only behind the contact and compliance gates.

workflow.label: Public home-care directory row
workflow.detail: Accept only PA Family/Group Child Care Home, NY GFDC/FDC, or TX licensed, registered, or listed home rows from the verified public datasets.

workflow.label: California small family home
workflow.detail: Reject before ingestion and dialing under the existing HSC 1596.86 guardrail.

workflow.label: Active-status filter
workflow.detail: Reject NY rows outside License/Registration and TX rows marked closed or temporarily closed.

workflow.label: NY phone omission
workflow.detail: Reject phone_number_omitted=Y before a name/contact row is created.

workflow.label: Published-role decision
workflow.detail: PA OWNER is owner evidence; NY provider and a TX person-named operation are provider candidates. A TX administrator/director is not an owner.

workflow.label: Administrator or unclear role
workflow.detail: Hold business-named TX operations whose only person is administrator/director; do not represent that person as an owner.

workflow.label: Published facility-contact field
workflow.detail: Use only a valid public facility phone field; it is a business-contact candidate, not a private-phone lookup or an owner-confirmed handset.

workflow.label: Remove home-location address
workflow.detail: Do not persist or export street, unit, geocode, or other residential-location data from home-care rows.

workflow.label: Contact and compliance hold
workflow.detail: Require the authorized line-type, DNC, suppression, time-zone, and reachability checks. No such outcome is measured here.

workflow.label: Eligible business contact
workflow.detail: Deliver only the permitted public business-contact record after all gates; preserve provider versus owner evidence.

failures.risk: Home-care source rows carry a residence-like facility address and current adapters persist street fields and most raw address fields.
failures.mitigation: Strip street/unit/geocode and raw facility, location, mailing, and legal-entity address fields before persistence; retain only the minimum non-residential routing fields if justified.

failures.risk: A TX administrator/director fallback is treated as a named contact when the operation name is a business, although that role does not establish ownership.
failures.mitigation: Hold or skip admin-only rows for owner targeting until independent owner evidence exists; retain a distinct provider/admin role if the product supports it.

failures.risk: NY records expressly suppress a phone with phone_number_omitted=Y.
failures.mitigation: Skip the whole contact row before name creation; the current NY adapter implements this filter.

failures.risk: A publicly listed facility phone may be a shared, landline, personal, or otherwise unsuitable number.
failures.mitigation: Do not infer cell status, owner reachability, or consent from field presence; apply authorized contact and DNC gates and record outcomes separately.

failures.risk: CA small family child-care homes are prohibited from dialing by the existing program guardrail.
failures.mitigation: Keep CA family homes excluded from ingestion and delivery.

sources.label: PA OCDEL provider directory
sources.scope: Family and Group Child Care Home rows; responsible person and published facility-contact fields.

sources.label: NY OCFS child-care directory
sources.scope: GFDC/FDC rows with provider and facility-contact fields, including phone omission marker.

sources.label: TX HHSC child-care operations dataset
sources.scope: Licensed, registered, and listed home rows with operation, administrator/director, status, and published facility-contact fields.

sources.label: CA CHHS Family Child Care Homes

iterations.hypothesis: The verified TX public endpoint exposes a bounded set of home-operation records without requiring personal contact collection for a coverage check.
iterations.test: Free live TX Socrata request on 2026-09-24, limit 20, selecting only operation_type, operation_status, and temporarily_closed; response was reduced immediately to aggregate counts.
iterations.observed: 20 rows returned: 10 home rows (1 Licensed Child-Care Home, 4 Registered Child-Care Home, 5 Listed Family Home), 20 active, and 20 not temporarily closed. No names, phone values, or addresses were retained.
iterations.change: Keep TX as an eligible public business-contact source, but make role and residential-data filtering explicit before any contact evaluation.

iterations.hypothesis: The TX phone field is broadly populated but cannot establish a usable owner phone.
iterations.test: Free live grouped TX endpoint aggregate on 2026-09-24 for the three home operation types, counting phone_number and administrator_director_name without selecting values.
iterations.observed: 4,704 eligible home rows and 4,667 populated phone fields; administrator/director is populated for 1,581 rows, almost entirely Licensed Child-Care Home rows. This is field presence only.
iterations.change: Do not claim phone verification or owner linkage; administrator-only paths remain held.

iterations.test: Focused synthetic regression checks in tests/lead-engine-industry-corrections.test.ts, lead-engine-reviews.test.ts, lead-engine-gates-jobs.test.ts and lead-engine-jobs.test.ts. No paid provider call.
iterations.observed: TX no longer substitutes administrator/director for an unresolved provider name. It holds the row with owner_identity_unresolved. Existing residential payload retention is not expanded and remains a separate limitation.
iterations.change: Shared runtime correction integrated. Original source samples are retained with their original denominators; no phone-yield improvement is claimed.

measurement.result: TX public endpoint metadata-only sample: 20 records, 10 home-operation records, all active and not temporarily closed. Separate source-wide grouped aggregate: 4,667 populated phone fields of 4,704 eligible home rows. No phone values, names, or addresses retained; verified phones, ownership, mobile status, reachability, and DNC outcomes are all unmeasured.

cost.basis: Free public TX Socrata metadata-only sample and grouped aggregate; no paid discovery, append, or verification was invoked.
cost.note: No cost per clean owner contact is supportable without measured ownership, authorized contact, and delivery outcomes.

implementation.summary: TX no longer substitutes administrator/director for an unresolved provider name. It holds the row with owner_identity_unresolved. Existing residential payload retention is not expanded and remains a separate limitation. Original review: PA, NY, and TX adapters exist; NY opt-out and activity filters are present. The current childcare adapters still persist home-location address data, and TX accepts administrator/director fallbacks as named records without owner evidence.

nextMeasurement: After residential-field removal and the administrator-only hold are implemented, run a consented 5-20 record audit that records separate denominators for source rows, role-evidenced providers, PA OWNER rows, valid published business-contact fields, authorized contact-gate passes, and delivered outcomes.
